scenario: 清分金额口径核对 · 扣款(debit)与退款(refund)同名 CTE 作用域影响分析样例

models.name: dwd_amount_flow
models.description: 金额流水明细层：外层 WITH flow 读扣款，FROM 派生表内层同名 WITH flow 读退款，按 SQL 作用域各自解析
models.sql: WITH flow AS (SELECT d.txn_id AS txn_id, d.order_id AS order_id, d.card_id AS card_id, d.line_id AS line_id, d.debit_amt AS flow_amt, d.debit_time AS flow_time FROM ods_debit_detail d WHERE d.city_code = '3301') SELECT f.txn_id AS txn_id, f.order_id AS order_id, f.card_id AS card_id, f.line_id AS line_id, f.flow_amt AS debit_amount, x.txn_id AS refund_txn_id, x.flow_amt AS refund_amount, x.flow_time AS refund_time FROM flow f INNER JOIN ( WITH flow AS (SELECT r.txn_id AS txn_id, r.order_id AS order_id, r.refund_amt AS flow_amt, r.refund_time AS flow_time FROM ods_refund_detail r) SELECT flow.txn_id AS txn_id, flow.order_id AS order_id, flow.flow_amt AS flow_amt, flow.flow_time AS flow_time FROM flow ) x ON f.order_id = x.order_id

models.name: dws_line_amount_summary
models.description: 线路金额汇总中间层：按线路读取明细层的扣款/退款金额
models.sql: SELECT w.line_id AS line_id, l.line_name AS line_name, w.debit_amount AS debit_amount, w.refund_amount AS refund_amount FROM dwd_amount_flow w INNER JOIN dim_bus_line l ON w.line_id = l.line_id

models.name: ads_settlement_amount
models.description: 结算广告层：结算净额 = 扣款金额 - 退款金额，扣款进入 WHERE 条件会整列污染结算口径
models.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT s.line_id AS line_id, s.line_name AS line_name, s.debit_amount AS debit_amount, s.refund_amount AS refund_amount FROM dws_line_amount_summary s) SELECT b.line_id AS line_id, b.line_name AS line_name, b.debit_amount AS settlement_debit, b.refund_amount AS settlement_refund, b.debit_amount - b.refund_amount AS settlement_net FROM base b WHERE b.debit_amount > 0
